site.note: TWO independent site leads were compared: (1) EIA-860M plant 64981 coords 31.05001,-96.221, STABLE across every EIA-860M snapshot 2022-04 through 2026-05 (eia_history.json) and consistent with the PGC registration physical address '9396 FM 3, South Normangee, TX 77871' (sources/2026-07-20_puct_59753-1_filing.pdf) — two independent primary sources agreeing on the South Normangee locale. (2) Ch.313 application #1703 'CG Leon County LLC' (confirmed SPV) Tab 16 map (sources/2026-07-20_comptroller_ch313_1703-normangee-cg-app_p26.png, dated 2019-12-04) shows a parcel-level 'Proposed Reinvestment Zone' polygon along FM 3 near the Robertson/Leon county line NW of Normangee (near Marquez, TX), ~15-20 km NW of the South Normangee point. Judgment call: the Ch313 map is dated 2019-12-04, predating the project's capacity shrink (300 MW in 2019 -> 132.98/130 MW current per queue_history.py/IA Exhibit C) and is more likely the ORIGINAL combined North+South reinvestment zone before descoping/re-siting than the current South-only footprint. Weight given to EIA-860M (2 independent sources, stable over 4 years) over the single 2019 static map. NOT a county centroid (playbook rule 4 — this is a specific address + stable plant-level coordinate).
